record.key: A threshold correction factor: Otsu's level is multiplied by it before it is used. Above 1 is stricter, so objects shrink and faint ones drop out; below 1 takes in dimmer pixels; 1 is Otsu's own level. Otsu detect uses it, and so does the Live magnifier's Otsu mode wherever a region holds two clear populations.
record.source: A threshold correction factor: Otsu's level is multiplied by it before it is used. Above 1 is stricter, so objects shrink and faint ones drop out; below 1 takes in dimmer pixels; 1 is Otsu's own level. Otsu detect uses it, and so does the Live magnifier's Otsu mode wherever a region holds two clear populations.
record.translation: Factor de corrección del umbral: el nivel de Otsu se multiplica por este valor antes de utilizarlo. Por encima de 1 es más estricto: los objetos se reducen y los tenues desaparecen; por debajo de 1 incluye píxeles más oscuros; 1 conserva el nivel original de Otsu. Lo utilizan tanto la detección con Otsu como el modo Otsu de la lupa en vivo cuando una región contiene dos poblaciones claramente diferenciadas.

retired_records.key:
Adds spaCR's DEBUG messages to the log files in ~/.spacr/logs. It also lets cellpose report which model it loaded, and it records which buttons you pressed. That trail is what makes a bug report worth reading.

Starting spaCR and opening its screens took no longer with this on. This was measured on one workstation by opening every module, once with this on and once with it off. Home was ready in about 4 seconds after a cold start both ways. The slowest module opened in about 7 seconds both ways. Pipeline runs were not timed.

The Console still shows only the levels you switch on for it on the Logging tab. This switch does not trace every function call. That tracer is a separate tool for developers, and nothing here turns it on.
retired_records.source:
Adds spaCR's DEBUG messages to the log files in ~/.spacr/logs. It also lets cellpose report which model it loaded, and it records which buttons you pressed. That trail is what makes a bug report worth reading.

Starting spaCR and opening its screens took no longer with this on. This was measured on one workstation by opening every module, once with this on and once with it off. Home was ready in about 4 seconds after a cold start both ways. The slowest module opened in about 7 seconds both ways. Pipeline runs were not timed.

The Console still shows only the levels you switch on for it on the Logging tab. This switch does not trace every function call. That tracer is a separate tool for developers, and nothing here turns it on.
retired_records.translation:
Añade los mensajes DEBUG de spaCR a los archivos de registro en ~/.spacr/logs. También permite que cellpose indique qué modelo ha cargado y registra qué botones ha pulsado. Ese historial aporta la información necesaria para investigar un informe de error.

Activar esta opción no aumentó el tiempo de inicio de spaCR ni el de apertura de sus pantallas. Se midió en una estación de trabajo abriendo cada módulo una vez con la opción activada y otra con ella desactivada. Inicio estuvo listo en unos 4 segundos tras un arranque en frío en ambos casos. El módulo más lento se abrió en unos 7 segundos en ambos casos. No se cronometraron las ejecuciones de los flujos de trabajo.

La Consola sigue mostrando únicamente los niveles que active en la pestaña Registro. Este interruptor no rastrea todas las llamadas a funciones. Ese rastreador es una herramienta independiente para desarrolladores y nada de lo que se configura aquí lo activa.

records.key: Close the holes inside what was thresholded, before it is labelled. A nucleus dimmer in the middle than at its rim comes back as a ring without this. The magnifier's Otsu mode has always done it and Otsu detect did not, which is why the two could disagree about the same field; now they both read this box.

The magnifier's Otsu mode has always done it and Otsu detect did not, which is why the two could disagree about the same field; now they both read this box.
records.translation: Rellenar los huecos dentro de la región umbralizada antes de etiquetarla. Sin esta opción, un núcleo más oscuro en el centro que en el borde aparece como un anillo. El modo Otsu de la lupa siempre lo hacía, pero la detección con Otsu no, por lo que podían discrepar sobre el mismo campo; ahora ambos utilizan esta casilla.
